thesaurus_reference: Upasargārtha-candrikā (A Thesaurus of Sanskrit Prepositional Verbs) by Mahāmahopādhyāya Charudev Shastri

sutras.scope: Lists the 22 prādi words (pra, parā, apa …) and makes them nipāta (under 1.4.56 प्राग्रीश्वरान्निपाताः)
Prādayaḥ are designated as 'Upasargas' when coupled with verbal actions
Prādayaḥ in verb connection also receive the designation 'Gati'

classical_doctrine.tri_vidha_gati_shloka: धात्वर्थं बाधते कश्चित् कश्चित्तमनुवर्तते । तमेव विशिनष्ट्यन्य उपसर्गगतिस्त्रिधा ॥
classical_doctrine.tri_vidha_gati_meaning_en: An upasarga works in three ways: one cancels (बाधते) the root's meaning, another follows (अनुवर्तते) it, and a third specialises (विशिनष्टि) it.
classical_doctrine.paradigm_transformation_meaning_en: By an upasarga the meaning of a root is carried by force to another sense, as with hṛ in प्रहार (blow), आहार (food), संहार (destruction), विहार (recreation) and परिहार (avoidance).
classical_doctrine.source_note: Both verses are traditional and widely quoted in grammatical literature; neither is a sūtra.

upasargas.meanings_en: forward, onward, forth, in front, intensely, beginning, excellence, manifestation
upasargas.meanings_hi: आगे, अधिक, प्रकर्ष, उत्पत्ति, आरम्भ, भली-भाँति, विशिष्ट रूप से
upasargas.meanings_te: ముందుకు, మిక్కిలి, విశిష్టత, ప్రారంభము, పుట్టుక, విస్తారము
upasargas.phonological_effects: Triggers ṇatva in following n (e.g. प्र + नम् = प्रणमति, प्र + नी = प्रणयति via 8.4.14).

upasargas.meanings_en: away, back, opposed, reverse, defeat, adverse, contrary
upasargas.meanings_hi: विपरीत, उलटा, पीछे, पराजय, अनादर, नाश
upasargas.usage_note: With जि it takes Ātmanepada (1.3.19 विपराभ्यां जेः): पराजयते = overcomes, defeats (शत्रून् पराजयते); with an ablative of what one cannot bear (1.4.26 पराजेरसोढः) = is worn out by (अध्ययनात् पराजयते). It does not mean “is defeated” in the active voice.

upasargas.meanings_en: away, off, down, deterioration, departure, bad, inferior, privation
upasargas.meanings_hi: दूर, हीन, बुरा, अलग, तिरस्कार, अभाव, विकृति
upasargas.usage_note: Away, off, or in a bad sense: अपगच्छति, अपहरति, अपवदति.

upasargas.meanings_en: together, with, completely, thoroughly, well, conjunction, perfection
upasargas.meanings_hi: अच्छी तरह, पूर्णतः, साथ, मेल, संयोग, सम्यक् रूप से
upasargas.phonological_effects: म् becomes anusvāra before a consonant (8.3.23 मोऽनुस्वारः), optionally the nasal of the next class (8.4.59 वा पदान्तस्य): संगच्छते / सङ्गच्छते. Before कृ it takes the augment स् (सुट्) in the sense of adorning (6.1.137 सम्परिभ्यां करोतौ भूषणे) and of assembling (6.1.138 समवाये च): संस्करोति; otherwise संकरोति.

upasargas.meanings_en: after, following, along, like, subordinate to, repeatedly, behind
upasargas.meanings_hi: पीछे, अनुसार, समान, निरन्तर, अनुकूल, छोटा
upasargas.usage_note: Sequence in time or space: अनुगच्छति, अनुकरोति, अनुसरति.

upasargas.meanings_en: down, off, away, low, below, comprehension, disrespect, cessation
upasargas.meanings_hi: नीचे, हीन, ज्ञान, अवमानना, उतरना, समाप्त होना
upasargas.phonological_effects: In the view of Bhāguri the initial अ may be dropped: अवगाहते / वगाहते (वष्टि भागुरिरल्लोपमवाप्योरुपसर्गयोः).
upasargas.usage_note: Downward movement or comprehension: अवतरति, अवगच्छति, अवजानाति.

upasargas.meanings_en: out, forth, without, free from, certainty, entirely
upasargas.meanings_hi: बाहर, रहित, बिना, निश्चय, पूरी तरह
upasargas.phonological_effects: स् becomes visarga at a pause; before श/ष/स it is visarga or the same sibilant (8.3.36 वा शरि): निःसरति / निस्सरति; before च it becomes श् (8.3.34 + 8.4.40): निश्चिनोति; before क/प it becomes ष् (8.3.41 इदुदुपधस्य चाप्रत्ययस्य): निष्कासयति.

upasargas.meanings_en: out, away, completely, without, definitive, outward movement
upasargas.meanings_hi: बाहर निकलना, पूर्णतः, बिना, रहित, निश्चयपूर्वक
upasargas.phonological_effects: Variant of निस्; र् stays before vowels and voiced sounds: निर्गच्छति, निरेति (निर् + इण्).

upasargas.meanings_en: bad, difficult, hard, painful, ill, wicked, adverse
upasargas.meanings_hi: बुरा, कठिन, दुष्ट, कष्टदायक, विपरीत
upasargas.usage_note: Used mostly before kṛt forms, especially खल् (3.3.126 ईषद्दुःसुषु कृच्छ्राकृच्छ्रार्थेषु खल्): दुष्करः, दुस्तरः. Finite verbs with दुस् are very rare.

upasargas.meanings_en: ill, difficult, wretched, unlucky, hard to attain
upasargas.meanings_hi: बुरा, कठिन, निंदनीय, अशुभ
upasargas.phonological_effects: र् stays before vowels and voiced sounds: दुर्लभः, दुर्गमः (both खल् forms, 3.3.126).
upasargas.usage_note: Like दुस्, used mostly in nominal forms; finite verbs with दुर् are very rare.

upasargas.meanings_en: apart, away, special, distinct, contrary, varied, distribution, privation
upasargas.meanings_hi: विशेष, अलग, विपरीत, विकृत, विस्तार, अभाव
upasargas.meanings_te: విశేషమైన, వేరుపడుట, విరుద్ధమైన, వికృతి, వ్యాప్తి, లోపము
upasargas.phonological_effects: Causes ष् in सद् and other roots (8.3.65, 8.3.66 सदिरप्रतेः): विषीदति.
upasargas.usage_note: Highly productive; separation, distinction or reversal: विजयते, विस्मरति.

upasargas.meanings_en: to, towards, back, up to, slightly, reversing direction (coming vs going)
upasargas.meanings_hi: तक, ओर, थोड़ा, उलटा करना (आना/लाना), स्वीकार
upasargas.phonological_effects: Written आ; ङ् is an it-marker. आ + vowel follows ordinary sandhi: आ + इ → ए (एति), आ + ऋच्छ् → आर्च्छ्.
upasargas.usage_note: Reverses motion roots: गच्छति “goes” → आगच्छति “comes”; ददाति “gives” → आदत्ते “takes”.

upasargas.meanings_en: down, into, back, thoroughly, completely, settling down, intensity
upasargas.meanings_hi: नीचे, भीतर, पूर्णतः, निश्चित, बैठना, रोकना
upasargas.meanings_te: క్రింద, లోపల, పూర్తిగా, నిశ్చయము, స్థిరపడుట, ఆపుట
upasargas.phonological_effects: Causes ष् in सद् (8.3.66 सदिरप्रतेः): निषीदति; and in सेव् (8.3.70): निषेवते.

upasargas.meanings_en: above, over, upon, sovereign, in addition, mastering, concerning
upasargas.meanings_hi: ऊपर, श्रेष्ठ, स्वामी, अधिकार, अध्ययन, पाना
upasargas.meanings_te: పైన, ఉన్నతమైన, అధికారము, ప్రభువు, చదువుకొనుట, పొందుట
upasargas.usage_note: With शीङ्, स्था and आस् the locus becomes the object (1.4.46 अधिशीङ्स्थासां कर्म): सिंहासनम् अधितिष्ठति.

upasargas.meanings_en: covering, closing, placing into, also, addition, concealment
upasargas.meanings_hi: ढकना, बंद करना, छिपाना, निकटता, भी
upasargas.phonological_effects: In the view of Bhāguri the initial अ may be dropped: अपिधानम् / पिधानम्, अपिदधाति / पिदधाति.

upasargas.meanings_en: beyond, across, past, excessive, extraordinary, surpassing
upasargas.meanings_hi: अधिक, पार करना, उल्लंघन, श्रेष्ठता, बहुत
upasargas.usage_note: Going beyond or excess: अतिक्रामति, अतिशेते, अतिरिच्यते.

upasargas.meanings_en: good, well, beautiful, easy, noble, auspicious, highly
upasargas.meanings_hi: अच्छा, सुंदर, सरल, शुभ, अधिक, प्रशंसनीय
upasargas.phonological_effects: As an upasarga it causes ष् in सुप्, सू, सम (8.3.88 सुविनिर्दुर्भ्यः सुपिसूतिसमाः): सुषुप्तः, सुषमः. In the sense of praise it is a karmapravacanīya (1.4.94 सुः पूजायाम्) and causes no ष्: सुसिक्तम्.
upasargas.usage_note: Rare with finite verbs; common before kṛt forms (सुकरः, सुलभः by खल्, 3.3.126).

upasargas.meanings_en: up, upwards, out, forth, rising, origin, superior, prominent
upasargas.meanings_hi: ऊपर, उठना, उत्पन्न होना, प्रकट होना, श्रेष्ठ
upasargas.phonological_effects: द् becomes त् before a voiceless sound (8.4.55 खरि च): उत्पद्यते; then assimilates: उच्छिनत्ति (8.4.40), उल्लिखति (8.4.60 तोर्लि); before स्था/स्तम्भ् the स् is replaced (8.4.61 उदः स्थास्तम्भोः पूर्वस्य): उत्तिष्ठति; ह् after it may become ध् (8.4.62): उद्धरति.

upasargas.meanings_en: towards, into, facing, over, against, completely, honoring
upasargas.meanings_hi: सामने, ओर, चारों ओर, सत्कार, श्रेष्ठता, आक्रमण
upasargas.usage_note: Movement towards a person or thing: अभिगच्छति, अभिभाषते, अभिवन्दते.

upasargas.meanings_en: back, towards, in return, against, every, opposite, repetition
upasargas.meanings_hi: विपरीत, बदले में, प्रत्येक, वापस, की ओर, उत्तर
upasargas.phonological_effects: Blocks the ष् of सद् (8.3.66 सदिरप्रतेः): प्रतिसीदति, not *प्रतिषीदति.
upasargas.usage_note: Return, response or opposition: प्रतिकरोति, प्रतिवदति, प्रतिगच्छति.

upasargas.meanings_en: around, round about, entirely, completely, avoiding, examining
upasargas.meanings_hi: चारों ओर, पूरी तरह, त्यागना, घूमना, भली-भाँति जांचना
upasargas.phonological_effects: Causes ष् (8.3.65, 8.3.66, 8.3.70): परिषीदति, परिषेवते; with कृ in the sense of adorning takes सुट् (6.1.137): परिष्करोति; ṇatva (8.4.14): परिणयति.
upasargas.usage_note: All around, completely, or avoidance: परिक्रामति, परिहरति, परीक्षते.

upasargas.meanings_en: near, towards, under, subordinate, commencing, worshiping, offering
upasargas.meanings_hi: निकट, पास, छोटा, गौण, आरंभ, सेवा करना, भेंट देना
upasargas.meanings_te: దగ్గర, ఉప- (చిన్న), ప్రారంభము, సేవించుట, బహుమానము ఇచ్చుట
upasargas.phonological_effects: With कृ takes सुट् in some senses (6.1.139 उपात्प्रतियत्नवैकृतवाक्याध्याहारेषु): उपस्कृतम्.
upasargas.usage_note: Nearness or secondary status: उपगच्छति, उपदिशति, उपकरोति, उपतिष्ठते.
